response.sql: WITH station_counts AS (SELECT o.observstation, COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count FROM observatories AS o LEFT JOIN telescopes AS t ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.observstation), station_shares AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, telescope_count * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(telescope_count) OVER (), 0) AS share FROM station_counts), ranked AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS above_average FROM station_shares) SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, above_average FROM ranked WHERE above_average > 0 ORDER BY above_average DESC LIMIT 10;
